description: The location at which a financial institution may be found or reached.

buildingNumber.description: The number, expressed as text, of the building on a street for this financial institution address.

cityId.description: The unique identifier of the city for this financial institution address, such as United Nations Location Code (UNLOCODE).

cityName.description: The name, expressed as text, of the city, town or village of this financial institution address.

countryId.description: The unique identifier of a country for this financial institution address (Reference ISO 3166 and UN/ECE Rec 3).

countryName.description: The name, expressed as text, of the country within this financial institution address.

countrySubDivisionId.description: The unique identifier of a country sub-division for this financial institution address (Reference ISO 3166 and UN/ECE Rec 3).

countrySubDivisionName.description: The name, expressed as text, of a country sub-division within this financial institution address.

departmentName.description: The name, expressed as text, of a department within this financial institution address.

financialInstitutionAddressTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of financial institution address.

lineFive.description: The fifth free form line, expressed as text, of this financial institution address.

lineFour.description: The fourth free form line, expressed as text, of this financial institution address.

lineOne.description: The first free form line, expressed as text, of this financial institution address.

lineThree.description: The third free form line, expressed as text, of this financial institution address.

lineTwo.description: The second free form line, expressed as text, of this financial institution address.

postOfficeBox.description: The post office box, expressed as text, for this financial institution address.

postcodeCode.description: The code specifying the postcode for this financial institution address.

streetName.description: The name, expressed as text, of the street or thoroughfare for this financial institution address.
